testScope: Project-maintained local CLI QA. Cached AWS Emulator image 1.0.511 in a transient Docker internal network (telemetry off), loopback-only forward. Generated per-run files were copied into owner-matched temporary test fixtures. Not an official-agent-skill installation test or independent package-signature re-verification.
probe: Only sts.GetCallerIdentity; no app source or SDK writes; no real AWS credentials or AWS cloud connection
verificationLimitations: The tool validates TLS and signed emulator account only. No provenance certification, IAM, AWS production parity, or application behavior is established.
hostNetworkGuard: Loopback-only destination enforced by worker and HTTP transport; container internal network. No public AWS requests performed.
dockerCleanup: The temporary owned Docker container, network, and loopback forward are cleaned after QA; no existing user resources are stopped or modified.
